$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. Expected feature reports worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/LenovoControllers: LenovoUSBController setDeviceSoftwareMode/getInformation/setZoneLeds/setDeviceHardwareMode with RGBController_LenovoUSB's constructor, SetupZones and DeviceUpdateLEDs; LenovoGen7And8USBController getCurrentProfileId/setLedsDirectOn/setLedsDirect/setLedsDirectOff with LenovoRGBController_Gen7_8's SetupZones and Direct path; layouts parsed from LenovoDevices.h) by a separate reference model (openrgb-work/batch2/lenovo/gen_usb.py in the porting session's scratch space, not in the repository); plugin.js was never run to make them. Each variant: the device's answers to the information / profile queries ('info': query id -> byte 4 of the reply; 'profile_reply': byte 4 of the 0xCA reply; absent or null = no reply), the zones OpenRGB picks, HueDeck's grid (size, LED names and cells: a matrix zone at its map cells, an LED missing from OpenRGB's map in the next free cell right of the LED before it, each linear zone one row, consecutive single-LED zones one shared row), two colour sets in LED order, and the I/O of Initialize, two frames and Shutdown. ops: send_report = SET_FEATURE (report id 0x07 first, whole buffer), get_report = GET_FEATURE of report 0x07. HueDeck deviations modelled here (docs/hardware/lenovo-legion-usb.md): Gen 7-10 Initialize skips OpenRGB's read-only brightness (0xCD) and profile-settings (0xCC) queries and never sends SAVE_PROFILE (0xCB); Shutdown sends hardware mode (0xB1) / direct off (D0 02) as OpenRGB's destructor / mode switch does.
